title: mangifera quadrifida var. spathulifolia
intro: Mangifera quadrifida var. spathulifolia, commonly known as the "Kalumpang" or "Rambai" tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Anacardiaceae. It is a native tree in Malaysia and Indonesia, known for its edible fruits and traditional medicinal uses. The health benefits of Mangifera quadrifida var. spathulifolia include its antidiabetic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help manage blood sugar levels, protect against cell damage, and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate blood sugar metabolism, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and show potential in treating various diseases, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
